def comps(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cells=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.add((a,b))
                    st+=[(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                out.append((col,cells))
    return out
def is_closed(cells):
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    sub=[[0]*(W+2) for _ in range(H+2)]
    for r,c in cells: sub[r-r0+1][c-c0+1]=1
    st=[(0,0)]; seen={(0,0)}
    while st:
        a,b=st.pop()
        for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            x,y=a+da,b+db
            if 0<=x<H+2 and 0<=y<W+2 and sub[x][y]==0 and (x,y) not in seen:
                seen.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
    return len(seen)<(H+2)*(W+2)
